name: BANHALMI media usage evidence

sourceDocument.dedupeMethod: Page-level SHA-256 over lowercased, whitespace-normalized extracted text. This is a capture-level dedupe only; separate captures of the same publication can remain distinct and are merged again at publication level.
sourceDocument.sourceScope: User-supplied media-usage evidence report covering March-April 2026. The report is evidence of captured usage, not proof that every captured page is a unique publication or that every visual match carries creator attribution.

publicationLevelRules: Merge duplicate page captures and alternate captures of the same article into one publication record.
Explicit creator credit is strongest when the publisher page itself names Norbert Bánhalmi/Banhalmi and Wikimedia Commons or otherwise identifies the creator.
A matching image without creator credit is visual-use evidence only and must not be upgraded to explicit authorship evidence without another source.
A page containing the user's own social profile, email address, personalized ad or navigation element is not external publication evidence by itself.
Publication/photo credit does not imply commissioning, client, partnership, endorsement, political affiliation or official-government-photographer status.
